# ML-09: Time-Series Machine Learning (Tier 1)

**Subtrack:** Machine Learning Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Lag features, leakage-free temporal validation, global models, sequence models and anomaly detection on streams.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 has a single assessment because foundational time-series reasoning is covered in DS-10. The ML unit concentrates on modelling at Tiers 2 and 3.

- **[ML-T1-019](ML-T1-019-the-forecast-that-peeked/README.md): The Forecast That Peeked: Building a Leak-Free Walk-Forward Backtest for Feeder Load.** Implement lag features, expanding-window walk-forward splits, a seasonal-naive baseline, MASE and a closed-form ridge autoregression for a synthetic daily feeder-load series, then explain why a backtest that peeks at the future is worthless.
